scenes.script:
Rahul says: Mere boss ne mujhe 'circle back' karne ko bola, toh main literally gol-gol ghumne laga!
Miss Nova says: 'Circle back' just means to discuss a topic again later. Main hoon Miss Nova, aapki personal AI English teacher.
Rahul says: Achha, toh iska ye matlab hai! Par main seekhu kaise? English bolne me mujhe bohot nervousness hoti hai, aur mere paas bilkul time nahi hai.
scenes.on_screen_text: MERE BOSS NE MUJHE CIRCLE BACK KARNE KO BOLA TOH MAIN LITERALLY GOL GOL GHUMNE LAGA CIRCLE BACK JUST MEANS TO DISCUSS A TOPIC AGAIN LATER MAIN HOON MISS NOVA AAPKI PERSONAL AI ENGLISH TEACHER ACHHA TOH ISKA YE MATLAB HAI PAR MAIN SEEKHU KAISE ENGLISH BOLNE ME MUJHE BOHOT NERVOUSNESS HOTI HAI AUR MERE PAAS BILKUL TIME NAHI HAI

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Supernova AI ke saath, aap actually bolkar seekhte hain. Main aapka exact level analyze karke aapke liye ek personalized plan banati hoon. Chahe raat ke 3 a.m. pe 1000 mistakes kariye, main aapko kabhi judge nahi karungi.
scenes.on_screen_text: SUPERNOVA AI KE SAATH AAP ACTUALLY BOLKAR SEEKHTE HAIN MAIN AAPKA EXACT LEVEL ANALYZE KARKE AAPKE LIYE EK PERSONALIZED PLAN BANATI HOON CHAHE RAAT KE 3 AM PE 1000 MISTAKES KARIYE MAIN AAPKO KABHI JUDGE NAHI KARUNGI

scenes.script:
Rahul says: Sacch me? Par mujhe karna kya hoga?
Miss Nova says: Hours tak scroll karna band kariye. Bas mere saath din me 15 minutes practice kariye. Supernova AI download kariye, aur 1 month me aapko apni confidence me visible progress dikhne lagegi.
scenes.on_screen_text: SACCH ME PAR MUJHE KARNA KYA HOGA HOURS TAK SCROLL KARNA BAND KARIYE BAS MERE SAATH DIN ME 15 MINUTES PRACTICE KARIYE DOWNLOAD KARIYE SUPERNOVA AI AUR 1 MONTH ME AAPKO APNI CONFIDENCE ME VISIBLE PROGRESS DIKHNE LAGEGI
